An invoice tells a customer what they owe you and when to pay.

## Steps

::::::steps
::::step{title="Open Sales › Invoices"}
In the menu on the left, select **Sales**, then **Invoices**. Select **New invoice**.

![The invoice list](images/invoices-list.webp)

:::legend
1. **Sales** in the main menu.
2. **New invoice** starts a new invoice.
:::
::::

::::step{title="Add the lines"}
Pick the customer, then add one line for each thing you are billing. The customer must already exist, see [add a customer](guide:sales/add-a-customer).

![Invoice lines](images/invoice-lines.webp)

:::legend
1. **Item**: what you are billing.
2. **Tax**: a [tax](guide:settings/set-up-taxes) for the line, if any.
:::
::::

::::step{title="Save or send"}
Select **Save as draft** to finish later, or **Send** to email it to the customer.
::::
::::::

## What happens next

The invoice shows in the list with the status you chose. To reduce what is owed later, [create a credit note](guide:sales/create-a-credit-note).
